summary: The Infernal Assembly lies within the Forge Heart — a colossal industrial forge where molten Discord energy is shaped into corruption engines. Muramite engineers and Discord‑forged constructs guard the assembly lines, while the Forge Core Titan oversees production.
history: Built by Discord‑forged architects to weaponize corruption essence.
Muramite engineers integrated Dominion machinery into the forge.
War‑Shade commanders used the Assembly to mass‑produce armaments.
The Forge Core Titan manifested as a living embodiment of the forge.
The Assembly continues to operate autonomously, producing endless constructs.
